name: Field
description: A form-field layout that associates one control with visible label, help, required, and error content.

controlId.description: Stable id of the single control labelled by this field.

label.description: Fallback visible label used when the label slot is absent.

description.description: Fallback help text used when the description slot is absent.

error.description: Fallback validation message used when the error slot is absent.

invalid.description: Marks the field invalid even when no error content is rendered.

required.description: Displays a visual required marker; native control state remains explicit.

default.description: The single native or component form control.

label.description: Visible label content that takes precedence over the label prop.

description.description: Help content that takes precedence over the description prop.

error.description: Validation content that takes precedence over the error prop.
